scope: isolated local user-systemd and real-browser validation only; installed port 1991 remained on 0.1.0-rc.13 and was not restarted or modified

scenarios.name: healthy managed and anonymous adoption
details: one running anonymous Mousepad and one managed fixed XFCE runtime were adopted across repeated manager restarts
the anonymous VNC/server/gateway/session PIDs remained 1078600/1078606/1078612/1079008
the managed XFCE VNC/server/gateway/session PIDs remained 1078529/1078550/1078559/1091908
runtime IDs, locked driver versions, session generations, and the Mousepad unsaved document remained intact
real Chrome observed the interruption and the SDK automatically reconnected RFB and input channels

scenarios.name: graceful state and restored session observer
details: an unsaved Mousepad document returned HTTP 409 and preserved its session; reattachment cancelled the blocked cleanup
after managed XFCE adoption, native XFCE logout emptied the session cgroup and was immediately classified as exited/stopped
the terminal application status was written to the unified manifest and the SDK emitted sessionended without automatic reconnect
forced anonymous stop and managed desiredState=stopped removed their manifests and exact units

scenarios.name: unhealthy stopped-session locked recovery
details: an anonymous Mousepad runtime was created from driver 1.5.0 with 1280x720 geometry and no running application session
the loaded catalog was changed to driver 9.9.0 with 1024x768 geometry and the recorded gateway unit was stopped
startup rejected adoption, stopped the remaining exact units, and recreated the same runtime ID
old VNC/server/gateway PIDs 1096283/1096331/1096336 were replaced by 1098874/1098880/1098894
the recovered runtime still reported locked driver 1.5.0 and 1280x720 while the new catalog reported 9.9.0 and 1024x768

scenarios.name: current-binary live-session fault protection
details: the release-gate binary ran on loopback 2097 with a real Chrome SDK client and accepted final adoption plus Chinese text in 1.2 ms
healthy restart retained runtime mousepad-final-2a60324218d8, session generation 1, VNC/server/gateway/session PIDs 1140947/1140972/1140977/1141910, and Mousepad PID 1141997
after the gateway was stopped, another manager restart preserved the still-live VNC/server/session and Mousepad PIDs instead of destroying the application
the API and durable manifest exposed the inactive gateway health error while keeping desiredState running and driver 1.5.0
explicit force then removed the manifest and all exact units

scenarios.name: current-binary durable graceful-stop ordering
details: a real Chrome client committed graceful durability plus Chinese text to Mousepad before stop
the unsaved application returned HTTP 409 after the shutdown hook and the manifest retained desiredState running with shutdown-blocked metadata
VNC/server/gateway/session PIDs 1168256/1168265/1168271/1168488 remained active while the save decision was unresolved
explicit force returned HTTP 200, removed the manifest, and left all exact units inactive

cleanup: the isolated manager, Chrome profile, runtime units, listeners, configuration, state, and profiles were removed with recoverable trash operations
